description: Test suite for the ChatLog component, validating behavior such as message pruning, rendering, and user prompt management.

classes.name: ChatLog
classes.description: A class representing a chat message log with methods to add, prune, render, and manage messages.

methods.name: addSystem
methods.description: Adds a system message to the chat log.

methods.name: startTool
methods.description: Initiates a tool interaction within the chat log.

methods.name: updateToolResult
methods.description: Updates the result of a tool interaction.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Adds a user message to the chat log.

methods.name: showBtw
methods.description: Displays a 'Between' message, typically a prompt or inline info.

methods.name: hasVisibleBtw
methods.description: Checks if the 'Between' message is currently visible.

methods.name: addPendingUser
methods.description: Queues a pending user message with optional timestamp.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Clears all messages, with an option to preserve pending user messages.

methods.name: restorePendingUsers
methods.description: Restores pending user messages after rebuild.

methods.name: countPendingUsers
methods.description: Returns the number of pending user messages.

methods.name: commitPendingUser
methods.description: Confirms a pending user message, removing it from pending list.

methods.name: reconcilePendingUsers
methods.description: Reconciles pending user messages against history using timestamps.
